title: J&K’s Young Football Lions storm to 3rd place

ai.summary: J&K's Under-14 Boys Football team won 3rd place at the 70th SGFI National School Games 2026, securing a podium finish in a competition organized by the School Games Federation of India.

facts.claim: J&K Under-14 Boys Football team secured 3rd Place at the 70th SGFI National School Games 2026
facts.quote: The J&K Under-14 Boys Football team has brought immense laurels to the Union Territory by securing a podium finish claiming 3rd Place at the prestigious 70th SGFI National School Games 2026 held at Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh.

facts.claim: The championship was organized by the District Education Officer, Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, under the aegis of the School Games Federation of India (SGFI)
facts.quote: The championship was organised by the District Education Officer, Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, under the aegis of the School Games Federation of India (SGFI).

facts.claim: The young footballers from J&K demonstrated exceptional teamwork and dominance on the pitch
facts.quote: Throughout the tournament, as per a DYSS statement, the young footballers from J&K demonstrated exceptional teamwork and dominance on the pitch, cruising through the league and knockout stages with commanding victories before defeating Chhattisgarh 4–0 in the third-place playoff.
